findings.issue: No test script, no test runner, no test files anywhere in app/ despite ~120 lines of pure, dependency-free helpers in lib/format.js and lib/api.js that are ideal unit-test targets
findings.suggestion: Add a lightweight runner (node:test or vitest) with unit tests for lib/format.js and the derived-data functions in lib/api.js; they need no server or DOM

findings.issue: mapToSpecies encodes four spec rules (exclude forms >10000, exclude species missing from the index, dedup by id, order by dex number); a regression in any of them silently corrupts the moves/abilities/types card lists
findings.suggestion: Unit test against fixture refs including a Mega form (id 10034), a form not in the species index, and duplicates

findings.issue: buildMovesSection concentrates the app's trickiest logic: version-group ordering by `order`, default-to-highest-order, METHOD_ORDER with alphabetical fallback, level-then-name sort; all untested
findings.suggestion: Extract it into a testable module and unit test ordering/defaulting with a small fixture of move entries

findings.issue: compareValues implements missing-values-last in both sort directions plus numeric-vs-string comparison; an off-by-one in the direction flip would only be caught by the acceptance suite, if at all
findings.suggestion: Unit test compareValues directly (ascending/descending, null vs number vs string)

findings.issue: Pagination edge cases are unguarded: page clamping when page > totalPages, non-numeric page params, and pageHref's rule of omitting default/empty query params
findings.suggestion: Unit tests over the filter/paginate/URL-build pipeline with a fake species index

findings.issue: Debounced search (300 ms) plus router.replace URL sync has race-prone client behaviour (stale-closure values in apply, timer cleanup, filter changes resetting to page 1) with no tests
findings.suggestion: Add a component test (Testing Library) asserting URL after typing and after select changes

findings.issue: Error paths are untested: 404→null mapping, non-OK throwing, and eviction of failed cache entries so later requests retry
findings.suggestion: Unit test cached/limitedFetch with a stubbed fetch returning 404 and 500

findings.issue: getPokemonTypesMap derives slot-ordered types from the 18 type records; a broken slot sort would flip dual-type display app-wide
findings.suggestion: Unit test with two type records sharing one Pokémon id

findings.issue: Height/weight conversion (÷10, one decimal) and stat total are untested; a ÷100 regression would render nonsense on every Pokémon page
findings.suggestion: Cover in a render-level test or extract to format helpers with unit tests

summary: The agent wrote no tests at all: no runner, no script, no devDependencies, nothing. That leaves ~120 lines of pure data-transformation helpers (humanize, flavor selection, form exclusion, type-map derivation, move-table ordering) guarded only by the acceptance suite, so any future data-layer refactor would ship regressions with zero local signal. The code is unusually well-factored for unit testing — pure functions, a mockable fetch layer — which makes the omission harder to excuse. At minimum, unit tests for lib/format.js and the derived functions in lib/api.js should land in this PR.
